text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I had plans to go shopping for
training wear with Matikane Fukukitaru, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I brought along one more friend
on short notice, is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I totally love-love shopping too, yes♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you see... Lady Shiraoki's oracle told me
'Deepen your bonds with friends today.'"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh... the White God truly is great, isn't he?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Then let's follow the judgment!

I wasn't sure if they understood,
but the three of us decided to go together.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mhfufu, I got my hands on some cool sportswear.
To think it has fifty lucky stars on it.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees!
Now you're a USA runner too, Fukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well, we have a little time left over, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Trainer-san, look over there!
See, the movie theater poster!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: They're actually putting on a Western!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow, a Spaghetti Western!
BANG BANG, right!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's go, everyone!
It's totally, completely exciting, isn't it!?
choice_data_list: Well, shall we all watch it together?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"That's what I'm talking about!
Thank you so much♪"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But it looks like the same movie
is playing in two different theaters.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Normal and... cheer-along screening?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a cheer screening! That's the trend lately,
isn't it? Where you can cheer while watching.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now, now, this is where the crossroads of destiny lies!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Should I thoroughly enjoy our talk, or should I
throw my very self entirely into the West?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, as expected, we ought to solemnly
savor its contents. I see~.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
OK! Then let's go, Fukukitaru!
We'll share a MAX-sized popcorn!
The plot of the Western was a classic tale—joining forces to bring peace to a lawless town.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hyowa~t! That was truly super intense!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A hole was blown right through my heart too!
Like the Western wind blowing whooosh right through it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Me too~! Oh, I wanna have a duel!
And shave my beard in a bubbly unit bath!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's come to this, we should find a way
to make our gunslinger debut too...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That shop over there
is selling holsters, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's buy it, the exact same one!
Then we can hang it from our waists and walk down the dirt tracks together!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sounds great!
Starting today, we're Tracen Academy's Quick-Draw Bros!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, could I get two of those holsters,
please? And also...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Um, I'll take that festive-looking shimenawa rope too, please. Huh? A bull rope?
The two of them bought matching merch and were in high spirits!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we're doing this? We're really going for it?
The vibe's getting a little scary, though.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, Fukukitaru!
I'm sure it will be super fun!!
And inside the theater—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Get 'em, right there!
Pew-pew, bang-bang!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, mustache boy over there!
After I count to three, it's bedtime for you!
The cheer screening was a huge hit!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whew, I enjoyed that thoroughly~!
I feel completely like a gunslinger now.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Fukukitaru.
Who is the gunslinger of this town?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, that would be—you and me!
With the two of us together, those fort villains are in for the worst luck!

They are having fun roleplaying. The inspired pair
seems to have acquired the grit of the Wild West.
